historical_references.reference: Jace, as a given name, is a variant of the name Jaschek, which has its origins in the Czech language and means 'God is gracious'. It has been used in the English-speaking world since the late 19th century.

The name Jayce gained popularity in the United States in the 1940s and 1950s due to the influence of Jaycees, an organization for young business and professional men that was founded in 1914. The name became associated with the group and was given to babies born during this period.

The name has also been adopted in Facebook Gaming and Discord communities, where gamers often use pseudonyms or unique usernames. These platforms facilitate community building and allow players to connect with each other, further popularizing the name Jayce.
